> 第2181章 他来了（第1页）
他来了（他来了（第22页）林浩三人为了不让大罗宗的人怀疑，假装久攻阵法难以脱困，一副困兽犹斗的样子。
林浩右手一挥，将超绝品神通掌中世界施展而出，天外世界场景快速蔓延，一瞬间就笼罩这片区域。
浓郁的天外世界力量，化作特殊神秘火焰，开始焚烧此地大罗宗修士的神魂、肉身、神识。
“以天外世界力量为根基的超绝品神通，这种类型的神通，我大罗宗雄霸天苍星域，也还是第一次见到。”
大罗宗合体境巅峰老者，目光看向林浩闪过贪婪之色，很想抓住林浩逼问超绝品神通的修炼之法。
可他很快脸上露出遗憾之色，因为此次有半步大乘境长老，逼问林浩还轮不到他。
林浩此次施展天外世界力量有所保留，仅发挥出天外世界力量五成不到的力量。
大罗宗布置的阵法轰鸣声不断，看起来岌岌可危，但就是差一点力量，没能轰开。
“不愧是以天外世界力量为根基的超绝品神通，倘若不是提前布置好大罗天牢阵，只怕拦不住此人。”
转眼，林浩三人就被困了数日时间。
那名大罗宗的半步大乘境强者，得知林浩三人在这颗修真星现身，乘坐大罗宗专门的传送阵，比做星空传送生意的星空宗掌控的大部分传送阵，还要快上很多倍的速度，朝着林浩三人赶来。
半步大乘境强者踏入林浩三人所在的修真星，人还未到，一股恐怖的威压，就在这颗修真星弥漫。
凡是感受到此人威压的修士，都忍不住身体发抖，不自禁的想要跪下，臣服，不敢抵抗。
这就是半步大乘境强者，掌握了一缕法则，可以抬手间镇杀九成九的合体境修士。
此人还未抵达林浩三人所在的区域，他的威压就在林浩三人所在之地的上空，形成一张巨大的脸，取代了苍穹，冷漠注视着下方的林浩三人，充满了压迫感。
“这就是半步大乘境强者的手段！”
林浩心头一惊，目中闪过凝重之色。
从天空中半步大乘境强者，以威压幻化的巨脸上，林浩感知到其蕴含的法则之力虽然只是微弱的一缕，却非常恐怖。

林浩连信仰魔龙那种与异仙强者有关的一缕意识都战斗过，面对半步大乘境强者，虽然目光凝重，内心却还算镇定。
“此人若是不动用半步大乘境修士掌控的一缕法则，我若是靠着自身实力与之交手，未必不能杀他。”
半步大乘境强者体内元力，实际和合体境巅峰修士差距不大，只是比合体境巅峰修士多了对法则的理解，能够操控一缕微弱的法则。

The latest chapter of Five Elements Immortal Emperor_Chapter 2181 He is coming Page 1_Five Elements Immortal Emperor 7200_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 2181 He is coming (page 1)
He is coming (He is coming (page 22)) In order not to make the people of Daluo Sect suspicious, Lin Hao and the other three pretended that it was difficult to escape from the trap after a long attack, and looked like trapped animals still fighting.
Lin Hao waved his right hand and unleashed the world in his palm. The scene in the outer world spread quickly, covering the area in an instant.
The rich power of the outer world turned into a special mysterious flame and began to burn the souls, bodies, and consciousness of the Daluo Sect monks here.
"A super-class magical power based on the power of the outer world. This type of magical power is the first time I, the Great Luo Sect, dominates the Tiancang Star Territory, have seen it."
The old man, who was at the peak of the Great Luo Sect's Fusion Realm, looked at Lin Hao with a look of greed. He wanted to catch Lin Hao and ask him about the method of cultivating extraordinary supernatural powers.
But a look of regret soon appeared on his face, because this time there was a half-step Mahayana elder, and it was not his turn to question Lin Hao.
Lin Hao had reservations about using the power of the outer world this time, and only used less than 50% of the power of the outer world.
The formation deployed by Da Luo Zong kept roaring and seemed to be in danger, but it barely had the strength to blast it away.
"It is indeed a superb supernatural power based on the power of the outer world. If the Daluo Tianlao Formation had not been arranged in advance, I might not be able to stop this person."
In the blink of an eye, Lin Hao and the others were trapped for several days.
The half-step Mahayana realm expert from the Da Luo Sect learned that Lin Hao and the others had appeared on this cultivation star. He took the Da Luo Sect's special teleportation array, which was many times faster than most teleportation arrays controlled by the Starry Sky Sect, which was in the starry sky teleportation business, and rushed towards Lin Hao and the others.
The half-step Mahayana realm expert stepped into the cultivation star where Lin Hao and the others were. Before they arrived, a terrifying coercion filled the cultivation star.
All monks who felt the pressure of this person couldn't help but tremble, and couldn't help but want to kneel down and surrender, not daring to resist.
This is a half-step Mahayana realm expert who has mastered a ray of law and can kill 99% of the Fusion realm monks with just a raise of his hand.
This person has not yet arrived at the area where Lin Hao and the others are, and his pressure is in the sky above the place where Lin Hao and the others are, forming a huge face, replacing the sky, looking indifferently at the Lin Hao and the others below, full of oppression.
"This is the method of a half-step Mahayana realm expert!"
Lin Hao was startled, and a solemn look flashed in his eyes.
From the half-step Mahayana realm powerhouse in the sky, Lin Hao sensed that the giant face transformed with pressure, although it was only a weak wisp of power of law, was very terrifying.
Lin Hao had even fought with a ray of consciousness related to the belief in the magic dragon and the powerful alien immortals. Facing the powerful half-step Mahayana realm, although his eyes were solemn, he was still calm in his heart.
"If this person doesn't use a ray of law controlled by a half-step Mahayana monk, if I fight with my own strength, I may not be able to kill him."
The energy in the body of a half-step Mahayana strongman is actually not much different from that of a peak Fusion Realm monk, but he has more understanding of the laws than a peak Fusion Realm monk and can control a weak law.
